name: ledger
description: A durable, id'd record of the questions an agent asks the human (one-word answers, optional ceiling) and the notes it records when it decides without asking, in one SQLite file. A CLI the agent runs, batch pastes applied line by line, and hooks (on by default, off per folder with /ledger:disable) that inject the open items at session start, deny AskUserQuestion until the question has a row and git push until the session has a note or an outcome, and refuse once a turn that leaves a plain-words answer unrecorded, asks with no row, or decides with no note. Every hook fails open.
